quest.title: Luhua Landscape
quest.description: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: This isn't right... This can't be right. Those statues' eyes don't light up...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Is my viewfinding technique wrong somehow? No, that can't be it...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Eyes... What eyes? This statue doesn't have any at all.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Oh, this is terrible. How will I paint like this...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: You... Oh, it's you, Traveler. Well, here's the problem: I've been looking for inspiration around the Luhua Pool, and I wanted to paint a few pictures to bring back with me.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: But I haven't been able to find a good angle, and so none of my paintings have been to my satisfaction.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I was so focused on taking the scenery in that I only realized that most of my paintbrushes and paints had gone missing when I arrived here.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I must have left them in the previous posts where I'd painted pictures. Could you help me look for them?

choices.text: Where did you paint those pictures?

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: Uh, actually... I don't quite remember myself. I was too engrossed in my painting each time to pay my surroundings much mind, so I can't give you very specific locations...

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: But I've only drawn two pictures in this area, so it can only be in those two places.

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: I'll give you these two paintings. I'm sure that I must have left my painting tools in the areas I was <color=#00E1FFFF>using as a reference</color> for those paintings.

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: Once you've found them, please bring them back to me. I'll keep looking around here... I'm sure there's a better angle to take.

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: I was too engrossed in my surroundings each time to pay attention to my surroundings, so I can't remember any specifics...

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: But I've only painted two pictures in this area, so it can only be in those two places.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Have you found my painting tools?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Found them.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Just as I thought, I left them in the place I was taking references from. I tend to put the things I've used on the ground while I paint out of habit.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: When I'm in too much of a rush, I tend to leave a lot of things behind. Thank you so much. If not for you, I'd have to go back into the city to buy more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're going to continue painting here?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Don't even mention it. I'd heard people say that these two statues have eyes that could light up, and that you could see that from afar.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Giant statues with blazing eyes, standing guard next to a mountain... It would surely have made an excellent painting.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: But when I came here, the statues were here, but there were no shining eyes to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I thought that I might have missed some special timing, or that my angle was off, which is why I've been walking around.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: But it seems that no matter where I stand, the scenery doesn't change...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: The only thing I've gotten out of the whole venture is this — I found it in the pond down there.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I have no clue what it is, but the more I look at it, the more it resembles an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: But if this is an eye, then there might be another similar rock nearby. People do have two eyes, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's my conjecture, anyway. Don't think too hard about it. This rock's of little use to me, anyway, so why don't you have it? Consider it thanks for helping me find my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Statues with shining eyes... I wonder what secrets one can uncover in Luhua Pool?

talks.objective: Look for Vermeer's paintbrushes and paints

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Statue
dialogues.text: (This statue's head has a hole in a head, and it seems something may be inserted into it...)

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: How will I find that one perfect view...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding that rock...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: About the rock? Why are you suddenly interested in that?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I picked it up while looking for a good view at <color=#00E1FFFF>Luhua Pool</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Do you want to go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Luhua Pool</color> to have a look?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: You'll have to keep a close eye out. There're all sorts of things in that pool, and I have no idea who threw it in there...

talks.objective: Unravel the secret behind Luhua Pool

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I should bring more materials to paint with next time...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Or maybe I should keep a memo of the things I lose instead...

talks.objective: Unravel the secret behind Luhua Pool

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Oh... So that's how it is! These two rocks really are the eyes of the two statues. Their eyes will only shine once you've slotted those stones in...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Looks like I'll be able to paint something great after all! I'm off to find a good angle! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Wonderful, absolutely wonderful...

talks.objective: Unravel the secret behind Luhua Pool

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, I found one too...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Did you? Let me have a look. Why, I never — they're identical.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Strange. There are even words carved into the back. Now, what do they say...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: "The stone sentinels hold the gate as such, against those who add not a finishing touch..." What does this mean?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Well, this rock's of little use to me, anyway, so why don't you have it? Consider it thanks for helping me find my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Actually, I have a thought. It's just a wild guess, but don't you think these two rocks look a bit like eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: If they really are eyes, do you think that the "finishing touch" has something to do with these two stones.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Well, it's just a guess, so don't think too hard about it. I'm going to look for other views, now — thanks for finding my tools for me!
